request.message: What percentage of senior leaders rate their quality programs as world class or advanced according to the research?

response.answer: According to the research, 71% of senior leaders rate their quality programs as world class or at least advanced [E1].

evidences.text:
RANKINGS OF QUALITY PROGRAMS 
According to the research, 71% of senior leaders rate their qual-
ity programs as world class or at least advanced. In comparison, 
60% of quality professional respondents instead rank their quality 
program as average or below average. This conclusion would not 
surprise Mark Chassin, MD, president and CEO of The Joint Com-
mission and co-author of recent analysis of why healthcare organi-
zations have failed to break through and close the high reliability 
gap.
